verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs say you can 'run it locally', and the official CLI lets you 'run a Chroma server locally on your machine', which covers the lightweight local instance for development. The getting-started flow sets Chroma up inside a local Python project. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the embedded in-process (no-server) mode, detail on suitability for small workloads or persistence options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of local use.
